Once codegen lands fastcompile-testsel 1 (`ExecTable::new` takes `spans: &[(ContentId, Vec<u8>)]` and folds the positions each function names into its `Bound`): `serve/unit/test/image.rs` `table` takes `spans: &[(ContentId, Vec<u8>)]` and passes it through, and `serve/unit/codegen.rs:820` passes `&side.spans`, the tables the same link takes. Nothing else changes for cargo; `compile.rs`'s `SPANS` in usercode's reached sets is yours to keep or drop as that path retires.
